subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘MARINE’ is coded as ‘100’ and ‘NORMAL’ is coded as ‘126’. How will ‘REALM’ be coded in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : First (10) is subtracted from the sum of the position values according to English alphabetic series then the resultant is multiplied by (2) . So, • ‘MARINE’ is coded as ‘100’
